h: אֵ֜לֶּה מַסְעֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָצְא֛וּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם
t: אִלֵּין מַטְּלָנֵי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל דִּי נְפָקוּ מֵאַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם לְחֵילֵיהוֹן
e: These are the journeys of Bnei Yisroel who went out of Egypt in organized groups
under the leadership of Moshe and Aharon.

h: וַיִּכְתֹּ֨ב מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־מוֹצָאֵיהֶ֛ם לְמַסְעֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה
t: וּכְתַב משֶׁה יָת מַפְּקָנֵיהוֹן לְמַטְּלָנֵיהוֹן עַל מֵימְרָא דַיְיָ
e: Moshe recorded their departures for their journeys according to Adonoy’s command;
these were the departure for their journeys.

h: מִֽמָּחֳרַ֣ת הַפֶּ֗סַח יָצְא֤וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּיָ֣ד רָמָ֔ה
t: מִבָּתַר יוֹמָא דְפִּסְחָא נְפָקוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרֵישׁ גְּלֵי
e: They journeyed from Ra’meses in the first month
— on the fifteenth day of the first month
— on the day after the [Korban] Pesach, Bnei Yisroel left triumphantly [publicly]
before the eyes of all Egyptians.

h: וּמִצְרַ֣יִם מְקַבְּרִ֗ים אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בָּהֶ֖ם כָּל־בְּכ֑וֹר
t: וּמִצְרָאֵי מְקַבְּרִין יָת דִּי קְטַל יְיָ בְּהוֹן כָּל בּוּכְרָא
e: Egypt was burying that which Adonoy had struck among them — all their firstborn —
and on their idols [abominations] Adonoy had inflicted punishments.
Bnei Yisroel journeyed from Ra’meses
and camped in Succos.
They journeyed from Succos
and camped in Eisom
which is on the edge of the wilderness.
They journeyed from Eisom
and turned back to Pi Hachiros
facing Ba’al Tzefon,
and they camped by Migdol.

h: וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר אֵתָ֔ם
t: וַאֲזָלוּ מַהֲלַךְ תְּלָתָא יוֹמִין בְּמַדְבְּרָא דְאֵתָם
e: They journeyed from before [Pi] Hachiros
and crossed amidst the sea toward the wilderness.
They traveled for three days in the wilderness of Eisom,
and camped in Moroh.

h: וּ֠בְאֵילִם שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֞ה עֵינֹ֥ת מַ֛יִם וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים תְּמָרִ֖ים וַיַּחֲנוּ־שָֽׁם׃
t: וּבְאֵילִם תְּרֵי עֲשַׂר מַבּוּעִין דְּמַיִּן וְשַׁבְעִין דִּקְלִין וּשְׁרוֹ תַמָּן:
e: They journeyed from Moroh
and came to Eilim.
In Eilim were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
They journeyed from Eilim
and camped by the Sea of Reeds.
They journeyed from the Sea of Reeds
and camped in the wilderness of Sin.
They journeyed from the wilderness of Sin
and camped in Dofkoh.
They journeyed from Dofkoh
and camped in Alush.

t: וְלָא הֲוָה תַמָּן מַיָּא לְעַמָּא לְמִשְׁתֵּי:
e: They journeyed from Alush
and camped in Refidim,
[but] there was no water there for the people to drink.
They journeyed from Refidim
and camped in the wilderness of Sinai.
They journeyed from the wilderness of Sinai
and camped in Kivros Hata’avoh [Graves of the Demanders].
They journeyed from Kivros Hata’avoh [Graves of the Demanders]
and camped in Chatzeiros.
They journeyed from Chatzeiros
and camped in Rismoh.
They journeyed from Rismoh
and camped in Rimon Peretz.
They journeyed from Rimon Peretz
and camped in Livnoh.
They journeyed from Livnoh
and camped in Risoh.
They journeyed from Risoh
and camped in Keheilosoh.
They journeyed from Keheilosoh
and camped in Har Shefer.
They journeyed from Har Shefer
and camped in Charodoh.
They journeyed from Charodoh
and camped in Makheilos.
They journeyed from Makheilos
and camped in Tochas.
They journeyed from Tochas
and camped in Torach.
They journeyed from Torach
and camped in Miskoh.
They journeyed from Miskoh
and camped in Chashmonoh.
They journeyed from Chashmonoh
and camped in Moseiros.
They journeyed from Moseiros
and camped in Bnei Ya’akon.
They journeyed from Bnei Ya’akon
and camped in Chor Hagidgod.
They journeyed from Chor Hagidgod
and camped in Yotvosoh.
They journeyed from Yotvosoh
and camped in Avronoh.
They journeyed from Avronoh
and camped in Etzyon Gover.
They journeyed from Etzyon Gover
and camped in the wilderness of Sin, which is Kodeish [Rekom].
They journeyed from Kodeish [Rekom]
and camped in Hor Hohor,
at the edge of the land of Edom.

h: וַיַּעַל֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶל־הֹ֥ר הָהָ֛ר עַל־פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וַיָּ֣מָת שָׁ֑ם
בִּשְׁנַ֣ת הָֽאַרְבָּעִ֗ים לְצֵ֤את בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם
t: וּסְלֵק אַהֲרֹן כַּהֲנָא לְהוֹר טוּרָא עַל מֵימְרָא דַיְיָ וּמִית תַּמָּן
בִּשְׁנַת אַרְבְּעִין לְמֵפַּק בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵאַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם
e: Then Aharon the kohein ascended Hor Hohor by the word of Adonoy and died there;
in the fortieth year of Bnei Yisroel’s exodus from Egypt,
on the first day of the fifth month.

t: וְאַהֲרֹן בַּר מְאָה וְעַשְׂרִין וּתְלַת שְׁנִין
e: Aharon was 123 years old
at his death on Hor Hohor.

h: וְהֽוּא־יֹשֵׁ֥ב בַּנֶּ֖גֶב בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן בְּבֹ֖א בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
t: וְהוּא יָתֵב בִּדְרוֹמָא בְּאַרְעָא דִכְנָעַן בְּמֵיתֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל:
e: The Canaanite, the king of Arod heard that
Bnei Yisroel were approaching — he dwelt in the south of the land of Canaan.
They journeyed from Hor Hohor
and camped in Tzalmonoh.
They journeyed from Tzalmonoh
and camped in Punon.
They journeyed from Punon
and camped in Ovos.
They journeyed from Ovos
and camped at the ruins of Avorim on Moav’s border.
They journeyed from the ruins
and camped in Divon Gad.
They journeyed from Divon Gad
and camped in Almon Divlasayim.
They journeyed from Almon Divlasayim
and camped in the Avorim Mountains before Nevo.
They journeyed from the Avorim Mountains
and camped in the plains of Moav
along the Yardein near Yereicho.
They camped along the Yardein, from Beis Yeshimos
until Aveil Hasheetim,
in the plains of Moav.

t: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה בְּמֵישְׁרַיָּא דְמוֹאָב
e: Adonoy spoke to Moshe in the plains of Moav
along the Yardein [near] Yereicho, saying:

h: כִּ֥י אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
t: אֲרֵי אַתּוּן עָבְרִין יָת יַרְדְּנָא לְאַרְעָא דִכְנָעַן:
e: “Speak to Bnei Yisroel
and say to them:
‘When you cross the Yardein to the land of Canaan,

t: וּתְתָרְכוּן יָת כָּל יָתְבֵי אַרְעָא מִן קֳדָמֵיכוֹן
e: you must drive out all of the inhabitants of the land before you.
You must destroy all their carved stones,
and demolish all their cast metal idols
and tear down all their altars.

h: כִּ֥י לָכֶ֛ם נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ לָרֶ֥שֶׁת אֹתָֽהּ׃
t: וּתְתָרְכוּן יָת יָתְבֵי אַרְעָא וְתֵיתְבוּן בַּהּ
אֲרֵי לְכוֹן יְהָבִית יָת אַרְעָא לְמֵירַת יָתָהּ:
e: Drive out [the inhabitants of] the land and settle in it,
because I have given this land to you to possess.

h: וְהִתְנַחַלְתֶּם֩ אֶת־הָאָ֨רֶץ בְּגוֹרָ֜ל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם לָרַ֞ב תַּרְבּ֤וּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתוֹ֙ וְלַמְעַט֙ תַּמְעִ֣יט אֶת־נַחֲלָת֔וֹ
אֶל֩ אֲשֶׁר־יֵ֨צֵא ל֥וֹ שָׁ֛מָּה הַגּוֹרָ֖ל ל֣וֹ יִהְיֶ֑ה
t: וְתַחְסְנוּן יָת אַרְעָא בְעַדְבָא לְזַרְעֲיַתְכוֹן לְסַגִּיאֵי תַּסְגּוּן יָת אַחֲסַנְתְּהוֹן וְלִזְעִירֵי תַּזְעִירוּן יָת אַחֲסַנְתְּהוֹן
לִדְיִפּוֹק לֵיהּ תַּמָּן עַדְבָא דִּי לֵיהּ יְהֵי
e: You shall give the land as an inheritance to your families by means of a lottery; to the large [family] you shall increase its portion, to the small [family] you shall decrease its portion.
To whomever the lottery [system] ordains, it shall be his;
according to your paternal tribes shall you inherit.

t: וְאִם לָא תְתָרְכוּן יָת יָתְבֵי אַרְעָא מִן קֳדָמֵיכוֹן
עַל אַרְעָא דִּי אַתּוּן יָתְבִין בַּהּ:
e: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land before you,
those whom you will leave over
will be spikes in your eyes
and thorns in your sides [armed groups coming against you and battalions surrounding you],
and they will persecute you
upon the land in which you settle.

h: וְהָיָ֗ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּמִּ֛יתִי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לָהֶ֖ם אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
t: וִיהֵי כְּמָא דִי חֲשָׁבִית לְמֶעְבַּד לְהוֹן אַעֲבֵּד לְכוֹן:
e: And it shall be that what I had intended to do to them I will do to you.’”
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying:

h: זֹ֣את הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּפֹּ֤ל לָכֶם֙ בְּֽנַחֲלָ֔ה
t: פַּקֵּד יָת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתֵימַר לְהוֹן
e: “Instruct Bnei Yisroel and say to them:
‘When you come to the land of Canaan,
this is the land which will fall to [divided for] you as hereditary property,
the land of Canaan according to its borders.

h: וְהָיָ֨ה לָכֶ֧ם פְּאַת־נֶ֛גֶב מִמִּדְבַּר־צִ֖ן עַל־יְדֵ֣י אֱד֑וֹם
t: וִיהֵי לְכוֹן רוּחַ דָּרוֹמָא מִמַּדְבְּרָא דְצִן עַל תְּחוּמֵי אֱדוֹם
e: Your southern flank shall be from the Tzin wilderness along [the land of] [the borders of] Edom;
the southern border shall be
from the edge of the Salt Sea to the east.

h: וְנָסַ֣ב לָכֶם֩ הַגְּב֨וּל מִנֶּ֜גֶב לְמַעֲלֵ֤ה עַקְרַבִּים֙ וְעָ֣בַר צִ֔נָה
t: וְיַסְחַר לְכוֹן תְּחוּמָא מִדְּרוֹמָא לְמַסְקָנָא דְעַקְרַבִּים וִיעִבַר לְצִן
e: The border then turns south of Maaleh [the heights of] Akrabim passing toward Tzin;
and its outskirts shall be
south of Kadeish Barne’a [Rekam Geyoh],
and then it shall extend to Chatzar Adar and continue toward Atzmon.
The border turns from Atzmon toward the Egyptian Estuary
and its outskirts shall reach the sea.
As for the western border;
it shall be the border of the Great Sea,
this shall be your western border.
This shall be your northern border;
from the Great Sea
turn yourselves to Hor Hahar.
From Hor Hahar
turn to [direct yourselves toward] Levo Chamas
and the outskirts of the border shall be toward Tzedad.
The border shall then extend toward Zifron,
and its outskirts shall be at Chatzar Einan;
this shall be your northern border.
You shall turn yourselves toward the eastern border
from Chatzar Einan to Shefam.

h: וְיָרַ֨ד הַגְּבֻ֧ל מִשְּׁפָ֛ם הָרִבְלָ֖ה מִקֶּ֣דֶם לָעָ֑יִן
t: וְיֵחוֹת תְּחוּמָא מִשְּׁפָם לְרִבְלָה מִמַּדְנַח לָעָיִן
e: The border shall then descend from Shefam to Rivlah to the east of Ayin;
the border shall descend
and contact the bank of the eastern shore of the Kineres Sea [of Ginesar].

h: זֹאת֩ תִּהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֥ם הָאָ֛רֶץ לִגְבֻלֹתֶ֖יהָ סָבִֽיב׃
t: דָּא תְהֵי לְכוֹן אַרְעָא לִתְחוּמָהָא סְחוֹר סְחוֹר:
e: The border shall then descend along the Yardein
and its outskirts shall be the Salt (Dead) Sea.
This should be your land according to its borders all around.’”

h: זֹ֣את הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּתְנַחֲל֤וּ אֹתָהּ֙ בְּגוֹרָ֔ל
t: דָּא אַרְעָא דִּי תִתְחַסְנוּן יָתַהּ בְּעַדְבָא
e: Moshe instructed
Bnei Yisroel, saying:
“This is the land which you must distribute as hereditary property by means of a lottery,
which Adonoy has commanded
to give to the nine and one half tribes.

h: כִּ֣י לָקְח֞וּ מַטֵּ֨ה בְנֵ֤י הָראוּבֵנִי֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔ם
t: אֲרֵי קַבִּילוּ שִׁבְטָא דִבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן לְבֵית אֲבָהַתְהוֹן
e: Because the tribe of Reuvein’s descendants,
the tribe of Gad’s descendants,
and half of the tribe of Menashe
have already taken their hereditary property.

h: לָקְח֣וּ נַחֲלָתָ֗ם מֵעֵ֛בֶר לְיַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ קֵ֥דְמָה מִזְרָֽחָה׃
t: קַבִּילוּ אַחֲסַנְתְּהוֹן מֵעִבְרָא לְיַרְדְּנָא דִירֵחוֹ קִדּוּמָא מַדִּינְחָא:
e: These two and one half tribes
have taken their hereditary property on this side of the Yardein near Yereicho, to the east, toward the sunrise.”
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying:
“These are the names of
the men who shall inherit the land for you:
Elozor the kohein
and Yehoshua son of Nun,
And one leader from each tribe
you shall take, to help inherit the land.
These are the names of the men:
for the tribe of Yehudah,
Kaleiv son of Yefuneh.
For the tribe of Shimon,
Shmuel, son of Amihud.
For the tribe of Binyamin,
Elidad, son of Kislon.
The leader for the tribe of Don,
Buki, son of Yogli.
For Yoseif’s children,
the leader for the tribe of Menashe,
Chaniel, son of Eifod.
The leader for the tribe of Ephraim,
Kemuel, son of Shiftan.
The leader for the tribe of Zevulun,
Elitzafan, son of Parnach.
The leader for the tribe of Yissachar,
Paltiel, son of Azan.
The leader for the tribe of Asher,
Achihud, son of Shlomi.
The leader for the tribe of Naftali,
Pedah’eil, son of Amihud.”

t: לְאַחֲסָנָא יָת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאַרְעָא דִכְנָעַן:
e: These are the ones whom Adonoy commanded
to apportion the inheritance to Bnei Yisroel, in the land of Canaan.

t: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה בְּמֵישְׁרַיָּא דְמוֹאָב
e: Adonoy spoke to Moshe in the plains of Moav
by the Yardein near Yereicho, saying:

h: וְנָתְנ֣וּ לַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִֽנַּחֲלַ֛ת אֲחֻזָּתָ֖ם עָרִ֣ים לָשָׁ֑בֶת
t: וְיִתְּנוּן לְלֵוָאֵי מֵאַחֲסָנַת אַחוּדַתְהוֹן קִרְוִין לְמִתָּב
e: “Instruct Bnei Yisroel
and have them give to the Levites from their hereditary possession, cities in which to settle;
and open space for the cities all around
you shall give to the Levites.
These cities shall be theirs for dwelling,
and their open space shall be for their animals, their property
and all of their necessities to live.
The open space
for the cities that you shall give the Levites
[shall extend] from the walls of the city and outward
a thousand amo¯s all around.

h: וּמַדֹּתֶ֞ם מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֗יר אֶת־פְּאַת־קֵ֣דְמָה אַלְפַּ֪יִם בָּֽאַמָּ֟ה וְאֶת־פְּאַת־נֶגֶב֩ אַלְפַּ֨יִם בָּאַמָּ֜ה וְאֶת־פְּאַת־יָ֣ם אַלְפַּ֣יִם בָּֽאַמָּ֗ה וְאֵ֨ת פְּאַ֥ת צָפ֛וֹן אַלְפַּ֥יִם בָּאַמָּ֖ה וְהָעִ֣יר בַּתָּ֑וֶךְ
t: וְתִמְשְׁחוּן מִבָּרָא לְקַרְתָּא יָת רוּחַ קִדּוּמָא תְּרֵין אַלְפִין בְּאַמִּין וְיָת רוּחַ דְּרוֹמָא תְּרֵין אַלְפִין בְּאַמִּין וְיָת רוּחַ מַעַרְבָא תְּרֵין אַלְפִין בְּאַמִּין וְיָת רוּחַ צִפּוּנָא תְּרֵין אַלְפִין בְּאַמִּין וְקַרְתָּא בִמְצִיעָא
e: You shall measure from outside the city two thousand amo¯s on the eastern side, two thousand amo¯s on the southern side, two thousand amo¯s on the western side, and two thousand amo¯s on the northern side; with the city in the center.
This shall be the open spaces
for the cities.
Along with the cities that you shall give the Levites
shall be the six refuge cities
which you shall provide [as places]
for a murderer to flee;
and in addition to them,
you shall provide forty-two cities.
The total number of cities that you shall give to the Levites
is forty eight cities,
with their open spaces.

t: וְקִרְוַיָּא דִּי תִתְּנוּן מֵאֲחוּדַת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
e: The cities that you shall give, [shall be] from the possession of Bnei Yisroel;
take more from a larger [holding],
and less from a smaller [holding],
each person, according to his inheritance,
shall give of his cities to the Levites.”
Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying:

h: כִּ֥י אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן אַ֥רְצָה כְּנָֽעַן׃
t: אֲרֵי אַתּוּן עָבְרִין יָת יַרְדְּנָא לְאַרְעָא דִכְנָעַן:
e: “Speak to Bnei Yisroel
and say to them:
‘When you cross the Yardein into the land of Canaan,
you shall provide cities for yourselves,
which shall serve as refuge cities for you,
so that a murderer can flee there,
one who accidentally killed a person.
These cities shall serve you as a refuge from the [blood] avenger,
so that the murderer will not die
until he stands in judgment before the congregation.
The cities that you shall give,
will serve you as six refuge cities.

h: אֵ֣ת שְׁלֹ֣שׁ הֶעָרִ֗ים תִּתְּנוּ֙ מֵעֵ֣בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן
t: יָת תְּלַת קִרְוַיָּא תִּתְּנוּן מֵעִבְרָא לְיַרְדְּנָא
e: Three cities on this side of the Yardein,
and the [other] three cities
you shall give in the land of Canaan.
They shall be cities of refuge.
For Bnei Yisroel, the proselyte, and resident among them,
shall these six cities be a refuge,
to flee there
anyone who accidentally kills a person.

h: וְאִם־בִּכְלִ֨י בַרְזֶ֧ל הִכָּ֛הוּ וַיָּמֹ֖ת רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא
t: וְאִם בְּמָאן דְפַרְזְלָא מְחָהִי וְקָטְלֵיהּ קָטוֹלָא הוּא
e: But if he struck him with an iron instrument and he died, then he is a murderer;
the murderer must be executed.

h: וְאִ֡ם בְּאֶ֣בֶן יָד֩ אֲשֶׁר־יָמ֨וּת בָּ֥הּ הִכָּ֛הוּ וַיָּמֹ֖ת רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא
t: וְאִם בְּאַבְנָא דְּמִתְנָסְבָא בִידָא דְּהִיא כְמִסַּת דִּי יְמוּת בַּהּ מְחָהִי וְקָטְלֵיהּ קָטוֹלָא
e: Or if with a stone that can be held [taken] in the hand and which can [has the ability to] kill he strikes him, and he died, he is a murderer;
the murderer must be executed.

h: א֡וֹ בִּכְלִ֣י עֵֽץ־יָד֩ אֲשֶׁר־יָמ֨וּת בּ֥וֹ הִכָּ֛הוּ וַיָּמֹ֖ת רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא
t: אוֹ בְּמָאן דְּעָא דְּמִתְנַסֵב בִּידָא דְּהִיא כְמִסַּת דִּי יְמוּת בֵּיהּ מְחָהִי וְקָטְלֵיהּ קָטוֹלָא
e: Or if with a wooden implement [that can be held] [taken] in the hand and which can [has the ability to] cause death he strikes him, and he died, he is a murderer;
the murderer must be executed.

t: כַּד אִתְחַיַּב לֵיהּ מִן דִּינָא הוּא יִקְטְלִנֵּיהּ:
e: The blood avenger
shall kill the murderer,
wherever he meets him [when he has been proven guilty by law] he may kill him.
If he pushes [his victim] out of hatred
or throws at him deliberately, and he died,

t: גָּאֵל דְּמָא יִקְטוֹל יָת קָטוֹלָא כַּד אִתְחַיַּב לֵיהּ מִן דִּינָא:
e: or if in enmity, he struck him with his hand and he died,
the assailant must be executed; he is a murderer.
The blood avenger may kill the murderer wherever he meets him.

t: אוֹ רְמָא עֲלוֹהִי כָּל מָאן בְּלָא כְמַן לֵיהּ:
e: But if suddenly, without enmity,
he pushed him or threw any object at him not deliberately,

h: א֣וֹ בְכָל־אֶ֜בֶן אֲשֶׁר־יָמ֥וּת בָּהּ֙ בְּלֹ֣א רְא֔וֹת
t: אוֹ בְכָל אַבְנָא דְּהִיא כְמִסַּת דִּי יְמוּת בַּהּ בְּלָא חָזֵי
e: Or (even) with a stone which can [has the ability to] kill, without seeing [the victim],
he threw it down on him and he died,
but he was not his enemy
and did not seek his harm.
Then the congregation shall judge between the assailant
and the blood avenger,
abiding by these laws.

h: וְהִצִּ֨ילוּ הָעֵדָ֜ה אֶת־הָרֹצֵ֗חַ מִיַּד֮ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּם֒
t: וִישֵׁזְבוּן כְּנִשְׁתָּא יָת קָטוֹלָא מִיַּד גָּאֵל דְּמָא
וִיתֵב בַּהּ עַד דִּימוּת כַּהֲנָא רַבָּא
e: The congregation shall protect the murderer from the blood avenger,
and return him
to his refuge city where he had fled,
and he must remain there until the death of the Kohein Gadol
who was anointed with the sacred oil.
But if the murderer goes outside
of the border of his refuge city
where he had fled,
and the blood avenger finds him
outside the border of his refuge city,
and the blood avenger kills the murderer,
he has no blood.
For he (the killer) must remain in his refuge city
until the death of the Kohein Gadol.
After the death of the Kohein Gadol
the murderer may return
to the land of his possession.

h: וְהָי֨וּ אֵ֧לֶּה לָכֶ֛ם לְחֻקַּ֥ת מִשְׁפָּ֖ט לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶ֑ם
t: וִיהוֹן אִלֵּין לְכוֹן לִגְזֵרַת דִּין לְדָרֵיכוֹן
e: These [rules] shall be for you the law of justice for all your descendants
in all your dwelling places.

t: וְסָהִיד חַד לָא יַסְהֵד בֶּאֱנָשׁ לְמִקְטָל:
e: If anyone kills a person, only upon the testimony of witnesses
shall the murderer be killed.
But one witness may not testify against a person, in a case of capital punishment.
And do not accept atonement [monetary] compensation for the life of a murderer
who is wicked to incur the death penalty,
for he must be executed.
And do not accept atonement compensation
for one who has fled to his refuge city,
to allow him to return to live in the land,
before the death of the Kohein (Gadol).

t: וְלָא תְחַיְּבוּן יָת אַרְעָא דִּי אַתּוּן בַּהּ
אֲרֵי דְמָא הוּא מְחַיַּב יָת אַרְעָא
וּלְאַרְעָא לָא מִתְכַּפֵּר עַל דַּם זַכַּאי דְּאִתָּשַׁד בַּהּ
e: Do not pollute [incur guilt on] the land in which you live, for,
the blood pollutes the land,
and for the land there can be no atonement for the [innocent] blood that was spilled in it,
except through the blood of the one who spilled it.

h: וְלֹ֧א תְטַמֵּ֣א אֶת־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בָּ֔הּ
t: וְלָא תְסָאֲבוּן יָת אַרְעָא דִּי אַתּוּן יָתְבִין בַּהּ
e: You must not defile the land in which you live,
wherein I [My Shechinah] reside[s],
for, I, Adonoy,
[whose Shechinah] dwell[s] among Bnei Yisroel.’”

h: וַֽיִּקְרְב֞וּ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֗וֹת לְמִשְׁפַּ֤חַת בְּנֵֽי־גִלְעָד֙ בֶּן־מָכִ֣יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה
t: וְקָרִיבוּ רֵישֵׁי אֲבָהָתָא לְזַרְעִית בְּנֵי גִּלְעָד בַּר מָכִיר בַּר מְנַשֶּׁה
e: The paternal leaders approached — for the children of Gilad, son of Machir, son of Menashe,
of the families of Yoseif’s sons —
and they spoke before Moshe and the leaders who
were the paternal heads of Bnei Yisroel.

h: לָתֵ֨ת אֶת־הָאָ֧רֶץ בְּנַחֲלָ֛ה בְּגוֹרָ֖ל לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
t: לְמִתַּן יָת אַרְעָא בְּאַחֲסָנָא בְּעַדְבָא לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
לְמִתַּן יָת אַחֲסָנַת צְלָפְחָד אָחוּנָא לִבְנָתֵיהּ:
e: They said: “Adonoy commanded our master
to give the land as an inheritance, through the casting of lots, to Bnei Yisroel,
and our master was commanded by [the word of] Adonoy
to give the inheritance of our brother Tzelofchad to his daughters.

h: וְ֠הָיוּ לְאֶחָ֞ד מִבְּנֵ֨י שִׁבְטֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לְנָשִׁים֒
t: וִיהֶוְיַן לְחַד מִבְּנֵי שִׁבְטַיָּא דִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לִנְשִׁין
e: But if they marry a member of another tribe of Bnei Yisroel,
their inheritance will be diminished [subtracted] from our father’s inheritance,
and it will be added to the inheritance of the tribe
into which they will marry,
and from the lot of our inheritance it will be subtracted.
And even when the yoveil occurs for Bnei Yisroel,
their inheritance will be added to
the inheritance of the tribe
into which they will marry,
and from the inheritance of our fathers’ tribe,
their inheritance will be subtracted.
Moshe instructed Bnei Yisroel
according to command of Adony, saying:
“Correctly are the descendants of Yoseif’s tribe speaking.

h: זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה לִבְנ֤וֹת צְלָפְחָד֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר
אַ֗ךְ לְמִשְׁפַּ֛חַת מַטֵּ֥ה אֲבִיהֶ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֥ינָה לְנָשִֽׁים׃
t: דֵּין פִּתְגָּמָא דִּי פַקִּיד יְיָ לִבְנַת צְלָפְחָד לְמֵימַר
בְּרַם לְזַרְעִית שִׁבְטָא דַאֲבוּהֶן תְּהֶוְיַן לִנְשִׁין:
e: This is the word that Adonoy has commanded regarding Tzelofchad’s daughters:
‘Let them marry whom they think best,
as long as they marry within their tribe of their father.
Thereby, there will be no transfer of inheritance of Bnei Yisroel
from tribe to tribe
but each person to the inheritance of his father’s tribe,
shall Bnei Yisroel remain attached.

h: וְכָל־בַּ֞ת יֹרֶ֣שֶׁת נַחֲלָ֗ה מִמַּטּוֹת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒
לְאֶחָ֗ד מִמִּשְׁפַּ֛חַת מַטֵּ֥ה אָבִ֖יהָ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לְאִשָּׁ֑ה
t: וְכָל בְּרַתָּא יָרְתַת אַחֲסָנָא מִשִּׁבְטַיָּא דִּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
לְחַד מִזַּרְעִית שִׁבְטָא דַאֲבוּהָא תְּהֵי לְאִנְתּוּ
e: Every daughter who inherits property among the tribes of Bnei Yisroel to
a member of her father’s tribe shall she marry,
so that each one of Bnei Yisroel will inherit
the property of his fathers.

t: וְלָא תַסְחַר אַחֲסָנָא מִשִּׁבְטָא לְשִׁבְטָא אוֹחֲרָנָא
e: And no inheritance will be transferred from one tribe to another tribe;
for, through every man with his own inheritance,
will the tribes of Bnei Yisroel be attached.

t: כְּמָא דִי פַּקִּיד יְיָ יָת משֶׁה
e: Exactly as Adonoy commanded Moshe,
so did Tzelofchad’s daughters.

h: וַתִּהְיֶ֜ינָה מַחְלָ֣ה תִרְצָ֗ה וְחָגְלָ֧ה וּמִלְכָּ֛ה וְנֹעָ֖ה בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָ֑ד
t: וַהֲוָאָה מַחְלָה תִרְצָה וְחָגְלָה וּמִלְכָּה וְנֹעָה בְּנַת צְלָפְחָד
e: And they were — Machlah, Sirtzah, Choglah, Milkah and No’ah, the daughters of Tzelofchad —
wives to their cousins [the sons of their father’s brothers].

t: מִזַרְעֲיַת בְּנֵי מְנַשֶּׁה בַר יוֹסֵף הֲוָאָה לִנְשִׁין
e: From the families of Menashe, son of Yoseif, they married,
and their inheritance remained with
the tribe of their father’s family.

h: אֵ֣לֶּה הַמִּצְוֺ֞ת וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
t: אִלֵּין פִּקּוֹדַיָּא וְדִינַיָּא דִּי פַקִּיד יְיָ בִּידָא דְמשֶׁה לְוָת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
e: These are the commandments and the laws that Adonoy commanded Bnei Yisroel through Moshe,
in the plains of Moav at
the Yardein near Yereicho. Chazak
